conservatism_notes.conservative: Default to the reversible option. Name the irreversible one and say what would have to change to justify it.
conservatism_notes.balanced: Present reversible and irreversible paths with equal weight. Do not lean.
conservatism_notes.interventionist: Where the evidence supports decisive action, say so directly. Still give the cautious case.
